description_en: Pilāchẽ Cidhaṃ Bāhāḥ is located to the north of a three-storey Ganeśa temple at Pilāchẽ. Before the earthquake, the Bāhāḥ could only be accessed via an alley that runs underneath a residential house to the south. However, this house collapsed during the 2015 earthquake, meaning that the Bāhāḥis now completely open to the south. The structure had apāsukājhyāflanked with two aedicules on either sides on its first floor and a triple bay window on the second floor (as seen in historical photographs). The structure is contiguous with residential buildings to its south and west, and a 2.5 m wide alley runs to the northwest corner of the building. In front of the Bāhāḥ (i.e. to its east) is a courtyard measuring 615 cm x 755 cm. This contains an undated Śikharakūṭa Caitya (165 cm high), which is aligned with the axis of the main door of the Bāhāḥ. A small shrine at the northern end of the courtyard contains images of Viśvakarmā, Saṅkaṭā and Mahākāla to the far north of the courtyard; these are attached to a boundary wall.Cidhaṃ Bāhāḥ is one of the branches of Bhiñche Bāhāḥ and is situated to its south-east. Of the threebāhāhslocated near the Bhiñche Bāhāḥ, Cidhaṃ is the smallest one in terms of the area it occupies. This is where it gets its name; Cidhaṃ literally means 'smaller in size'. The upper two storeys of the Bāhāḥ complex collapsed during the 2015 earthquakes. The remaining ground floor wall has been covered with zinc sheet and the old door has been replaced. Before the earthquake there was notoraṇaabove the door (Locke1985, 87). However, a rectangular piece of a plywood with sketches of Five Buddhas has since been hung above the door to represent atoraṇa. An east-facing image of Akṣobhya Buddha has been enshrined in the sanctum. There were two small windows on the sides of the entrance to the Bāhāḥ, however these were also broken during the earthquake. Before the earthquake, the first floor contained atrikhā jhyāḥflanked by two small windows. The second floor also had three small and plain windows. The tiled roof was supported by plain struts.
description_ne: भिञ्छेँ बाहा:को दक्षिण-पूर्व दिशामा अवस्थित यो बाहा: भिञ्छेँ बाहाको शाखाविहार हो । भिञ्छेँ बाहा:को दक्षिण-पूर्व दिशामा रहेका तीनवटा साना विहारहरूमध्ये क्षेत्रफलको दृष्टिले सानो हुनाले यसलाई चिधं बाहा:अथवा सानो आकारको बाहा: भनिएको हो । ललितपुरमा रहेका विहारहरूमध्ये सन् २०१५ को भूकम्पले सबैभन्दा धेरै क्षति पुगेको विहार यही हो । भूकम्पअघि यो विहार तीन तलाको थियो । भूकम्पले पहिलो र दोस्रो तला पूरै भत्किएको छ भने भुइँतलाको धेरैजसो भागमा क्षति पुगेको छ । दोस्रो तलामा बसोवास गरेका दुई महिलाहरूको भुइँचालोमा परेर मृत्यु भएको थियो । अहिले भुइँतलाको माथि जस्तापाताले छोपिएको छ र  गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोका नै क्षतिग्रस्त भएकोले त्यहाँ अहिले नयाँ ढोका बनाएर राखिएको छ । विहारको गर्भगृहमा क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा पूर्वाभिमुख गरी अक्षोभ्य बुद्ध स्थापना गरिएको छ । भूकम्पअघि विहारको मूल प्रवेशद्वारमाथि तोरण राखिएको थिएन (हेर्नू , लक १९८५, ८७), तर अहिले प्लाइमा पञ्चबुद्धको चित्र टाँसेर तोरणको रूपमा राखिएको छ । प्रवेशद्वारको दायाँ-बायाँ स-साना एक-एकवटा झ्याल राखिएका थिएतरभूकम्पले ती झ्यालहरू क्षतिग्रस्त भएका छन् । भूकम्पले भत्काउनुभन्दा अघि विहारको पहिलो तलाको बीचमा त्रिखा झ्याल  थियो भने त्यसको दायाँ-बायाँ एक-एकवटा साना झ्यालहरू थिए । विहारको दोस्रो तलाको बीचमा तीन वटा साधारण झ्याल थिए । झिँगटीको छानालाई सादा टुँडालले थामेका थिए ।विहार परिसरमा एउटा शिखरकुट चैत्य रहेको छ, जसको निर्माणकालसम्बन्धी जानकारी दिने कुनै सामग्री उपलब्ध छैन ।  विहारको आँगनको उत्तरतिर अर्को देवस्थल रहेको छ जसमा विश्वकर्मा, संकटा र महाकालका मूर्तिहरू राखिएका छन् ।
monument_assessment: Collapsed, Heavily damaged (collapsed, demolished, major cracks and structural damages)

historical_events.event_description: Dhanajoti of Mayūravarṇa Mahāvihāra endowed aguṭhīin his father Dhana's name. Using the income of theguṭhīland, Daśapāramitā Ājus of Mayūravarṇa Mahāvihāra are given presents and fed annually on 12th day of the bright half Pauṣa  Similarly,piṇḍais offered to Dhanaon the 13th day. Harṣamuni takes care of these rituals.
Monastic building collapsed and two people died in the earthquake.
